questions: Is a route the same in both directions? For example, if you add Circle to Madina, should a passenger asking for Madina to Circle get the same fare?
Should only station staff be able to add routes and change fares, for example with a password, while passengers can only look fares up?
If there is no direct route between two stops, should the system add up fares across connecting routes, or just say no route was found?
answers: Yes. Circle to Madina costs the same as Madina to Circle, so we keep one route for both directions and passengers can ask either way.
Say it was not found. Do not try to join two routes together; only direct routes count.
